canonical_title: Anthropic plans enterprise data-retention shift allowing customer-controlled cloud storage
aliases: Anthropic enterprise data retention own cloud
treatment: Treat as an enterprise privacy, safety, and retention-policy topic. Reinclude only for official rollout details, effective dates, technical architecture, customer eligibility, safety-system details, material changes to the 30-day requirement, or confirmed customer impact.
known_facts: Reuters reported on 2026-08-20 that Anthropic plans to keep a 30-day enterprise retention requirement for advanced models while allowing business customers to retain the data on their own cloud infrastructure.
The proposed system has reportedly been developed with more than 100 customers, including Salesforce.
Anthropic is also expected to introduce a new safety system later in 2026.
Anthropic had announced in June that enterprise traffic for Fable, Mythos, and future frontier models would be retained for 30 days to help detect cyber misuse.
reinclude_only_if: Anthropic officially publishes the revised retention architecture, rollout date, or eligible products and customers.
The 30-day retention requirement is materially shortened, extended, removed, or given new exceptions.
The planned safety system is launched with technical details or materially changes misuse monitoring.
A major enterprise customer confirms a material deployment, privacy, compliance, or availability consequence.
notes: NEW because the planned customer-controlled retention location and associated enterprise architecture were not present in the sharded ledger. The policy remains reported rather than officially published, so future official documentation is the strongest follow-up trigger.
